totals.scope: All80 records including16warmups. Wall span includes preparation/resume/gaps; process minus render includes loading/output/shutdown and is not shutdown alone.

hardware.scope: Inventory collected after measured runs; not temperature/clock/utilization telemetry.

limitations: Renderer-local matched medium/clear workload cost only; no GPU-vs-CPU absolute speed ranking.
Engine wall includes scheduling/frameCPU/terminal GPU completion wait; current output/loading/shutdown excluded. PBRT uses its native render-loop time.
Eight timing ratios across two blocks are descriptive, not eight independent image-noise seeds or a confidence interval.
Bare fixed-wavelength clear brightness differs; use each renderer vacuum-normalized medium variance, not raw cross-renderer RGB/noise acceptance.
Four-seed variance estimates are descriptive; no equal-error efficiency claim.
No historical pre-feature binary measurement or causally isolated bottleneck.
All internal evidence remains local; public additions are comparison images and measured results.
